players.product: CRPS / M-CRPS server power supplies (incl. 3200W CRPS for AI data centers) and industrial PSUs

quarterly_data.quarter: FSP Technology press release: FSP Launches Next-Gen 3200W CRPS Power Solutions to Fully (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FSP announced two new 3200W Common Redundant Power Supply (CRPS) modules, both certified 80 PLUS Titanium and supporting PMBus: the FSP3200-20HM (12V output, standard 1U form factor, for mainstream enterprise data centers, storage, workstations and edge nodes) and the FSP3200-21HE (54V output, for next-generation high-density AI servers, multi-GPU clusters and high-voltage DC architectures). Both support EDPP (Electrical Design Power Peaks), delivering short-duration peak output above rated power to absorb AI GPU load surges.

quarterly_data.quarter: FSP Technology press release: FSP Launches Next-Gen 3200W CRPS Power Solutions to Fully (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FSP said it is expanding its high-density product roadmap and that higher-wattage CRPS solutions are scheduled for release in the second half of this year (2026), for future advanced AI clusters and next-gen accelerator cards.
